sources.text: the ledger report is useless to me in the morning. its a wall of numbers and i dont know what to do with it. i want to open tinkery and in like 5 seconds know if yesterday went well or not. maybe one number? useful changes per hour is the one that matters. cost too maybe. i dont want a dashboard. also the 6am job sometimes fails silently and i only find out days later
a failed job should override everything. cost only matters if its way off

parts.outcome: I know in about 5 seconds whether yesterday went well, using useful changes per hour and possibly cost
parts.when: in the morning when I open Tinkery
parts.why: The ledger report is a wall of numbers, so I do not know what to do with it; the 6am job sometimes fails silently and I find out days later
must: Useful changes per hour is included
The result is not a dashboard
must_not: The result must not be a wall of numbers

unresolved_notes: A single number may be useful
What observable check shows that I know whether yesterday went well
A full dashboard appears inconsistent with your stated preference
The main goal is quickly judging yesterday's performance, while silent-job detection is a separate related goal.
'yesterday went well' can be evaluated using useful changes per hour, with cost possibly included.
